name: Barbell bench press
steps: Lie on the bench with feet firmly planted and eyes beneath the bar.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and keep your shoulder blades back.
Lower the bar with control toward your mid-chest, keeping wrists stacked.
Press upward without bouncing. Use a spotter or safety bars.
breathing: Breathe steadily. Exhale during the effort and inhale during the controlled return when comfortable.
mistakes: Using momentum instead of controlling the movement.
Choosing a range or load you cannot comfortably control.

name: Incline dumbbell press
steps: Set the bench to a comfortable low incline.
Hold dumbbells beside your chest with wrists above elbows.

name: Seated shoulder press
